tools.name: InspectGeometryFile
tools.description: Load one 3D geometry file and report its measurements — vertex and triangle counts, bounding-box extent, surface area, watertightness — and, unless render is false, return a rendered image of it to look at. Paths come from ListGeometryFiles.

path.description: The file to inspect: a path from ListGeometryFiles, or an absolute path inside a search root.

render.description: Return a rendered image of the mesh. True by default; set false when only the numbers are wanted.

yawDegrees.description: Camera orbit around the vertical axis in degrees. Ask again with a different value to see another side.

pitchDegrees.description: Camera height above the horizon in degrees. Positive looks down on the object.

wireframe.description: Draw the triangle edges over the shading. Useful for judging mesh density; illegible above about 50,000 triangles.

tools.name: ListGeometryFiles
tools.description: List the 3D geometry files (OBJ, STL, PLY, glTF/GLB, FBX, DAE) available to inspect. Call this before InspectGeometryFile to find out what paths exist.

nameContains.description: Only list files whose name contains this text, case-insensitively. Omit for all of them.

limit.description: At most this many files, 1..500. Defaults to 40.
